summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 7,352,942 shares of common stock by Viridian Therapeutics at $17.00 per share, expected to raise $117.5M in net proceeds. Concurrently, the company is conducting a $225M convertible senior notes offering due 2032. The offerings are not contingent on each other. This is a routine capital raise filed under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation transaction. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation elements involved.
